messages:
Amira Patel: Hi folks — I'm planning to be in Warsaw for ~4 months (2026-05-12 to 2026-09-10). Staying on Redwood payroll. Quick Qs: can I keep my US homebase? How does the $200 WFH stipend work overseas?
Diego Ramos: You can request temporary remote for up to 6 months. Homebase can remain US for that window, but we need approval + a signed addendum. Stipend usually continues monthly and is prorated.
Kara Liu: Also check benefits: we do a benefits exception for >90 days. Medical may be out-of-network for some services. I'll start that flow if approved.
Amira Patel: I plan to keep my US bank and W-2. No local clients.
Payroll Bot: Payroll note: "For temporary international work under 6 months, US payroll remains unless local registration is required. Update temporary address if needed."
Diego Ramos: Tax note: Poland uses a 183-day rule; ~4 months typically won't create tax residency but document dates. If you receive PLN salary or register locally, that creates nexus.
Amira Patel: Cool. For equipment: can ops ship a spare monitor to avoid customs?
Ops Logistics: We can ship from EU hub if we have 10 business days' notice. If we provide equipment up front, we may offset its value vs stipend — we'll confirm.
Amira Patel: Sounds good. I'll opt for EU-hub shipping and keep USD stipend. What's the stipend calc? $200 x number of approved months?
Diego Ramos: Yes, $200 per approved month. If equipment is provided and not returned, we reconcile its cost.
Kara Liu: I'll kick off benefits review and DM the temporary remote addendum. Please add an emergency contact in the form.
Amira Patel: Thanks — I'll fill the form tonight. Appreciate the help. :pray:
